detail.longDescription: I would think this goes without saying, but apparently it does need to be said. If you're developing a Minecraft mod that violates it's TOS (whether for a bullshit reason or not) or is at least in merky waters in that regard, please have the common sense not to host the source code on GitHub. If you do host the source code on GitHub, do not be surprised when the source code of a mod breaking TOS on a Microsoft owned game gets taken down on a Microsoft owned Git hosting service. Do not be surprised if your pleads to Microsoft/GitHub (no matter how reasonable) are completely ignored. #Minecraft #Gaming #VideoGames #Modding #Microsoft #GitHub
